get.description: OpenAPI version of the FreshCart metrics lookup: the semantic layer. Return one official FreshCart business number for a period of 2024, optionally split by city, region or month. Use this for revenue, order counts, refund claim counts and the refund rate. Test accounts are always excluded; revenue counts delivered orders only; refund rate means claims per order.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The period: YYYY-MM (a month), YYYY-Qn (a quarter) or YYYY (the whole year), within 2024

parameters.name: breakdown
parameters.description: Split the number by this; leave out for one number

200.description: The number, or ok false with a message
